probe_meta.label: dense-G (controlled retrieval-mechanism swap of Probe G)

response_text:
1) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

2) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker __for controlled release of said oil and gas field chemical__.

3) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine __and said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

4) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, __and said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

5) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate, __and said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

6) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions, __wherein said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

7) (Original) The composition of claim 4, wherein said anionic surfactant is selected from the group consisting of sodium dodecyl sulfate, sodium lauryl sulfate, alcohol propoxy sulfate, olefin sulfonates, and alpha olefin sulfonates.

8) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __and said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

9) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater, __and said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

10) (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

11) (Original) The composition of claim 10, said polyalkylenimine being less than 2000 Da.

12) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation __for controlled release of said oil and gas field chemical__.

13) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al __and said composition being for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

14) (Original) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle for delivery of an oil and gas chemical to a reservoir, said composition comprising a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion intimately associated with an oil and gas field chemical to form a polyelectrolyte complex, said complex having an average particle size of less than one micron.

15) (Original) A composition for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical comprising: a) a polyanion and a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da forming a polyelectrolyte complex; b) said polyelectrolyte complex intimately associated with an oil and gas chemical selected from the group consisting of a (a) a gel-forming or cross-linking agent, (b) a scale inhibitor, (c) a corrosion inhibitor, (d) an inhibitor of asphaltene or wax 3 COP: 42166USdeposition, (e) a hydrogen sulfide scavenger, (f) a hydrate inhibitor, (g) a breaking agent, and (h) a surfactant; and c) said polyelectrolyte complex having an average particle size less than 1000 nm.

16) (Original) The composition of claim 15, said polyanion comprising PVS.

17) (Original) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than 2000 Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS) intimately associated with a zirconium ion crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said nanoparticle has a predominance of negative charges and the amount of PVS exceeds the amount of PEI.

18) (Original) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than 2000 Da and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS) intimately associated with a zirconium ion crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, wherein said nanoparticle has a predominance of positive charges and the amount of PEI exceeds the amount of PVS.

19) (Original) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine (PEI) of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion intimately associated with a metal ion crosslinker, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate) poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate, dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants, and where the metal ion crosslinker is selected from aluminum, iron, titanium, chromium, zirconium and complexes of same.

20) (Original) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a delayed gelling agent comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyethylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyvinyl sulfonate intimately associated with a multivalent metal cation crosslinker, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron; 4 COP: 42166USb) a polymer having anionic sites that can be crosslinked with said metal cation crosslinker; and c) a fluid.

21) (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer [[thai]] __that__ can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer __and said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

23) (Original) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide.

24) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethyacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acryamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, or [[NN, dimethy ac.ylamide]] __N,N-dimethylacrylamide__ __and said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

25) (Original) The composition of claim 20, where said metal crosslinker is zirconium or aluminum.

26) (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater __and said composition is for controlled release of an oil and gas field chemical__.

27) (Original) An improved method of sweeping a reservoir, wherein an injection fluid is injected into a reservoir to mobilize and produce oil, the improvement comprising injecting the composition claim 1 plus a polymer plus a fluid into a reservoir, aging said composition and polymer to increase its viscosity, injecting additional injection fluid into said reservoir to mobilize oil, and producing said oil.

28) (Original) A method of improving sweep efficiency of a fluid flood of a reservoir, said method comprising: a) injecting the composition of claim 20 into a reservoir; b) aging the composition to increase its viscosity; c) injecting an injection fluid into said reservoir to mobilize the oil; and d) producing said mobilized oil.
